leads.reply_hint: Fill in the parts marked [ ]. After sending, set the status to "Contacted".
leads.reply_empty: No draft yet. Hand it to the assistant to write one in the buyer's language; it shows up here.
leads.reply_req_hint: The assistant follows these every time it drafts a reply. Change your signature, pricing wording, tone or length here — the next draft follows the new version.
leads.title: Inquiries
leads.desc: Form submissions from your site come in as they happen, sorted by real or not, intent and what they want (quote, samples, custom). Open one to research the buyer, draft a reply and log follow-ups; switch to Board to manage deals by stage.
leads.m_high_hint: High intent, not yet won or lost
leads.no_site: No site channels yet. Add a site under Sites & accounts and its form submissions will sync here.
leads.offline: Open the back office from Annulo to sync inquiries.
leads.empty: No form submissions yet. Once someone submits a contact or quote form on your site, it shows up here right away. If the site has no form, ask the assistant to add a quote form.
leads.all_spam: Only real inquiries are shown, and every submission so far was judged a pitch, spam or test. Switch to All to see them.
leads.open_page: Open the page it was submitted from ↗
leads.m_day_hint: Real inquiries in the last 24 hours
leads.m_week_hint: Real inquiries in the last 7 days, vs the 7 days before
leads.m_won_hint: Inquiries marked as won, all time
leads.search: Search company, name, email, country, message…
leads.board_hint: Drag a card to another column to change its stage. Spam / invalid ones are not on the board.
leads.research_empty: Have the assistant look into this buyer: what their website says they do, how big they are, how old the domain is, any risks, then a pricing angle and next steps. You can watch it work in the chat on the right; the result shows up here.
leads.research_hint: Research is for your eyes only; replies never mention it to the buyer. Where nothing could be found, the assistant says so instead of guessing.
leads.log_placeholder: Log a follow-up: called them, sent a quote, they asked for samples…
leads.log_empty: No follow-ups yet. Changing the stage, drafting a reply or researching the buyer logs one automatically.
leads.reply_empty_research: No draft yet. Research the buyer first for a sharper reply (pricing angle, which documents to send).

formhook.title: Receive form inquiries
formhook.desc: Your WordPress form plugin posts each submission to this address, so it lands in Inquiries right away and is checked automatically. Just paste the address into the plugin's Webhook settings — it already carries the key.
formhook.key: Key (only if a tool asks for it separately: header {header}, or hidden field {field})
formhook.howto: How to set it up in each plugin
formhook.elementor: Elementor Forms: edit the form → Actions After Submit → add "Webhook" with the URL above.
formhook.wpforms: WPForms: Settings → Webhooks (needs the Webhooks addon) → add, URL above, request format JSON.
formhook.cf7: Contact Form 7: install "CF7 to Webhook" and put the URL above in the form's Webhook tab.
formhook.other: Zapier, Typeform and others: POST to the URL above, JSON or form encoded.
